title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Nexus: 3001
overview: After the fall of Earth at the hands of its own creators, the remnants of humanity seek refuge on Nexus, a red planet where hope once thrived. Now, it endures under the rule of Kovino, the God whose authority is absolute and unquestioned. As quiet whispers of an old prophecy begin to resurface among the people, speaking of their savior named Wadha. As a reluctant rebel named Eli finds himself drawn toward a decision that may disturb the fragile order and set something far greater into motion for their savior to return.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
overview: The second live-action adaptation of the animated trilogy. Plot TBA.

title: Relentless
overview: The story of a former soldier and an underground fighter who is diagnosed with cancer and is left with the decision to keep fighting to provide for his family in the long run. The joint battle with cancer versus the battle in the arena.

title: Wings
overview: A student on a field trip imagines himself as a classic pilot to work up the courage to talk to his crush.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: The Elephant's Present
overview: James comes home for the holidays with the intention of repairing the strained relationship with his daughter.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: I HAD A... (DREAM)
overview: I HAD A... (DREAM) unfolds as a trip where dance, stop-motion animation, sound, and imagery interplay, far from established dimensions and expectations. Mushrooms immerse the viewer in a dreamlike space, where the film becomes a site for deviation and disruption.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: Little Flower
overview: An ominous dream pushes Layla, a directionless twenty-something to reconnect with an old friend.

title: Whiddy
overview: A small rural community in Ireland welcomes in a major, global oil company with open arms but just 10 years and numerous oil spills later, that dream turns into an unimaginable nightmare. 50 lives lost in a tragedy that silenced and divided the community and still haunts it to this day.

title: Zinnia
overview: Zinnia is a solitary woman, blind from birth, she conceals a sword inside her wlaking stick for self-defense. When she learns that Tony has been kidnapped Zinnia will have to use her skills to survive and rescue Tony from a deadly threat.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Dislocated Thumbs Part 1
overview: An experimental short film that follows the creator's headspace as he grapples with the loss of his memory, identity, and mind, which are twisted by overlapping influences.

title: Growing Up... Sucks!
overview: He's sick of growing up and tries to rekindle his childness, but it just doesn't feel the same.

title: Ruckus
overview: A study session is interrupted by an irritating racket.

title: Finding Faith
overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

title: Primetime Production Diary
overview: Go behind the scenes with Primetime director Lance Oppenheim in a new making-of mini doc directed by Wes Ellis and Christian Vazquez & edited by Wes Ellis.

title: Nnéoma
overview: A mother's greatest mistake becomes her chance at redemption when love demands the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Something That Sticks
overview: A conversation between Derrick Gloop and William Fletch about the worst masks known to humanity- the ones that don't cover your face.

title: American Woodcock
overview: What's that buzzy sound? It's the woodcock, baby!

title: The Corselet
overview: Inspired by Andrea Mantegna's 'The Triumphs of Caesar ', shot on 16mm and hand-processed using nettles from Cornish woodlands, this film acts as a follow-up to Dubieniec's eco-somatic debut short 'Moth Wood'

title: i. exists
overview: In 2008, a landmark court ruling in the Philippines allowed Jeff Cagandahan, an intersex man to legally change his name and gender marker. 16 years later, his historic win inspired many others to come out—yet, as their visibility grows, it unveils harsh societal prejudices proving that the fight for true acceptance is only just beginning.

title: A Vision for Vision
overview: Directed and produced by 2x Emmy-award winning filmmaker Wayne Chesler, this special documentary follows Irish nutritional scientist Professor John Nolan’s 20-year exploration of the link between powerful antioxidants - Carotenoids - and their effects on nutrition, vision, and brain health. From the marigold fields of Mexico to research labs in Ireland, the Omega-3 enriched Norwegian seas, and elite performance centers in Singapore, the film uncovers breakthrough science behind these incredible nutrients that support how we see, think, and age.

title: Holiday House Divided
overview: After their mother's death just days before Christmas, two estranged sisters return home for the reading of a will that could change everything. Years earlier, a betrayal involving the man they both loved shattered their relationship. Now, during a tense holiday reunion filled with family, memories, and secrets, Mama Pat's final words force them to confront a past neither of them escaped.

title: Coroliocus, Unfortunately
overview: A tyrannical wizard forgets his name.

title: TOMORROW(?)
overview: A guy spends a night out with his childhood best friend for what seems like the last time.

title: Warm Blooded Animals
overview: Under vanilla skies, two dreamers lust for a life of freedom in a restless age of discontent. The young lovers stand at the precipice of adulthood, lingering on a stage in life where they could fade into oblivion or burst into flames.

title: Complications
overview: No longer working for the CIA, Dietrich is now a ruthless mercenary on a mission to execute a high value target. But all is not what it seems, and before long the mission becomes a lot more complicated than Dietrich could have imagined.

title: Walking in Circles: Shinjuku with Hisayasu Sato: Part 5
original_title: Walking in Circles: Shinjuku with Hisayasu Sato: Part 5
overview: Hisayasu Satô revisits the locations in Shinjuku where he shot the films featured on the Volume 5 anthology from Vinegar Syndrome.

title: Home of the Uninhabitable
overview: A young woman refuses to hide her emotional edges while learning to craft home in a world that is historically uninhabitable.

title: ENDGAME: Trump’s Midterns
overview: Trump's midterms: Democracy under threat in America. From Washington DC to Mississippi, South Carolina, New York, Tennessee and Colorado, Four Corners reporter Mark Willacy investigates whether the greatest threat to the elections comes from within the Trump administration itself. Donald Trump may not be on the ballot, but the election is a referendum on his presidency. With his approval rating at a record low, Trump is rallying his MAGA base, warning of electoral fraud and impeachment if the Democrats take control of Congress. Former Trump insiders are sounding the alarm over efforts to undermine confidence in the vote, including the prospect of ICE agents being deployed at polling places. Their warning: a desperate president could go to extraordinary lengths to cling to power.

title: Director's Cut
overview: While filming an audition tape for a reality television show, Keith Thomas, a film nerd, goes camping in the woods, only to make a shocking discovery as to why the campsite is eerily quiet.

title: The Chaser
overview: A desperate young man who is looking for love goes to an enigmatic potion seller to buy a love potion.

title: faust.os
overview: A girl seeks love by making a pact with an entity emanated from technology, attempting to preserve her privacy and her humanity while chatting with her new artificial lover.

title: Summer Alone
overview: Gage, an orphan, documents her final moments in Adelaide, Australia, before she moves across the world to be with her long-distance partner. As her partner is busy with work, he asks her to make a film for him.

title: LYCEUM
overview: After the entire student body mysteriously drops out, a young and obedient maths teacher must survive an absurd training session to land the first job he so desperately needs.

title: The Holiday Spark
overview: Firefight Dean enlists illustrator Laura to help plan a holiday party for his firehouse. As they plan the epic party, both begin to question their views on romance and the possibility of love at first spark.

title: The Nutcracker Wish
overview: After Clara, a small town dance teacher, is gifted a 'magical' Nutcracker, the real-life version shows up at her front door. But what seemed a holiday serendipity may instead destroy her family legacy.

title: A Royal Christmas Switch
overview: When Prince Alexander of Belvaria crosses paths with Ethan, a small-town man who looks like his twin, they decide to swap places for the Christmas season so Alexander can finally experience a normal holiday.

title: Pride of Scotland
overview: In the heart of Edinburgh, a renowned Kilt manufacturer works to preserve a centuries-old Scottish tradition while training the next generation to carry it forward.

title: Live through this
overview: Jane Remover offers a candid look into the realities of touring as a musician. This documentary follows the behind-the-scenes moments, travel experiences, and performances that define life on the road, balancing the pressures of fame with the artistic dedication required for live shows.

title: Summer's End
overview: Grace has spent the summer looking after her dad, who is still mourning over the loss of his wife who died when Grace was a child. When her unpredictable older brother Oscar brings his friends to stay with them, Grace is forced to confront her relationship with the past and her expectations of the future.

title: Blood Money
overview: After their train robbery turns bloody at the hands of Texas Rangers, the survivors of one of America's last outlaw gangs rendezvous at their safehouse where they investigate who, if anyone, sold them out to the law.

title: Power-Man
overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.

title: The Mosquito Bowl
overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: Riverrun
overview: Lucy is a musician who is slowly losing control over her body and voice. Her psychiatrist Dr. Cruz sends her to a clinic in Spain where she meets Tony. What begins as a treatment slowly becomes a journey towards an unexpected understanding of herself.

title: Miss Holloween
overview: Halloween has come to Hatchetfield, and with it an army of demonic monster-masks who set out to terrorize the tiny town. The only one standing in their way is Hatchetfield's mysterious, witchy guardian, Miss Holloway. But when she makes a deadly deal with the Lords In Black, Miss Holloway is in for more tricks than treats.

title: Holding
overview: While waiting on hold for insurance approval, a sickly man starts to hear unsettling sounds through the line that unravel a sinister secret about his claim.

title: Ho‘olono
overview: Hoʻolono, meaning “to listen deeply,” is a cinematic act of listening and an exploration of return, responsibility, and our evolving relationship to land and self. Hoʻolono is an invitation to listen deeply, to remember that the path through ecological crisis may also be a path back to ourselves.

title: Gamophobia
overview: Simon is ready to take the next step and start a relationship, but there's one problem: he can't seem to figure out how Jayden truly feels about him. Jayden is more timid when it comes to love, keeping her feelings close to her chest and leaving Simon wondering whether she feels the same way he does.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: ALAEA
overview: A grief-stricken son faces a series of strange events after finding blood dripping from his father’s attic.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: Stage Kiss
overview: When an intimacy coordinator must advise a real-life couple on a classic scene, unlikely history between both girls blurs the line between love and forbidden desire.

title: Pronouncement of Doom
overview: After being executed by a corrupt king, a knight returns from the dead to seek revenge.

title: Amy Winehouse: Back to Black at 20
original_title: Amy Winehouse: Back to Black at 20
overview: A star-studded line-up of singers alongside The Amy Winehouse Band to perform each song from the record, live in a concert held at the Roundhouse in Amy’s beloved Camden.

title: Secrets of Mercy Hospital
overview: Returning to the working-class town she fled as a teenager, Kendra confronts the long-buried secret of the baby daughter she left behind. Facing pain, guilt and unanswered questions, she searches for healing, forgiveness and a second chance.

title: Last Dollar Til
overview: Twins on the way. His home sold out from under him by his own father. A man paralyzed by stagnation must reckon with the brutal distance between the dreamer he once was and the man he's become.

title: Frida: The Girl Just Doesn't Go Away
overview: Explores the transformation from artist to icon of Mexican painter Frida Kahlo, one of the most recognized influencers of our time. The many representations of her, beyond a single image have been appropriated by diverse groups from Chicanx and Mexican identity, disability to queer representation, just some of the diverse groups within which Frida Kahlo has become an inescapable reference and symbol. An extraordinary and unique phenomenon, Fridamania! Combines the iconic, mythic with an inexhaustible consumer culture.

title: The Watch
overview: Dave, a down-on-his-luck salesman is about to lose his job when he unearths a box containing a watch and a gun. Discovering that the watch gives him the ability to travel back in time, it dramatically reshapes his life, and the lives of the people around him.

title: Menopause After Dark: A Musical Comedy
original_title: Menopause After Dark: A Musical Comedy
overview: In an eight-minute musical fever dream, a woman ricochets through hot flashes, wellness  noise and five original songs until she finally stops pretending she is fine.

title: Fuck You, Dolphins
overview: Dolphins, they're everywhere. They're in our biggest oceans and fanciest pools. They've made their way into our movies, our sports teams, and even our bedrooms– like in an under-the-sea themed bedspread sort of way and also because some people want to have sex with them. Yes, everyone loves dolphins, but should they? No. Join intrepid reporter Charlotte Swett as she exposes the horrifying truth: these traitors to mammalia are sleep-deprived junkies who love to murder and also do sexual abuse stuff.

title: Last Stand at Butte City
overview: In 1880 Montana, a reclusive rancher is given 30 days to abandon her homestead when the railroad claims her land, forcing her to confront the trauma that has bound her to it for decades.

title: Montana Lucky
overview: Montana, 1972. Full-time lover, part-time cowboy, small-time thief - Lucky Corrigan dreams of becoming a dime-novel outlaw. But after rustling cattle from a peaceful hippy commune, he realizes he may have underestimated their commitment to the revolution.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
original_title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
overview: We’re all just floating, waiting for someone to find us.

title: A Second Chance Christmas
overview: Anna and James Campbell have been divorced for five years, their once-happy union now a carefully managed truce for the sake of their children. When their daughter invites the entire family to meet her serious boyfriend over Christmas at her grandparents’ rustic Smoky Mountain cabin, the former couple reluctantly agrees. Arriving a day early to avoid awkwardness, Anna is surprised to find James has the same idea. But when the worst ice storm in a decade traps them in the mountains with no way out, the exes are forced to confront the history they share – and the possibility that their story may not be finished after all.

title: Animals
overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: Burned Edges
overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

title: Doing Life
overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Dogwood
overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: This Is Our City
overview: The ambitious son of a ruthless mob boss hires a film crew, who end up being undercover FBI agents, to document his life as a dysfunctional and delusional gangster.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Jeffrey's Turn
overview: Jeffrey’s Turn based on a true life story of a young Mi’kmag man, Collin Sylliboy on the cusp of adulthood who embarks on a life changing road trip with an almost mythic figure from his past; his uncle Buck. Heeding an urgent call from his uncle, Collin has an adventure that opens his eyes to his Uncle’s tragic past of false incarceration stemming from generations of racism.  As the road unwinds, together they overcome the obstacles that are thrust in their way both externally and internally by ghosts from his uncle’s dark past. With grim determination and humor these two men bond together forever marking young Collin as he finally steps into manhood.  Jeffrey’s Turn with its universal message of coming to terms with your past while learning to live in the present is both hopeful but realistic in its portrayal of living as a Mi’kmag man in today’s society

title: The Second Assignment
overview: A film student in the midst of a moral crisis struggles to come up with a concept for his next short film.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Infinitely Dense
overview: Tom, a painfully pragmatic solipsist, disenchanted with his life, employs an augmented reality system to rejuvenate his life, only to discover the unintended dark and disturbing consequence of manipulating reality.

title: Sunlight Water
overview: When a lonely, recently single woman rescues a houseplant in need of serious TLC – and then falls in love with it – she must discover what the plant really wants, or risk losing herself forever.

title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
original_title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
overview: Damien Malvolio is a fresh face in the acting scene, he gets handed an audition of a lifetime with a big name director from his hometown (Ransom Wells). His best friend Rigby Hollander is also an actor that gets handed the same role. Rigby Gets the part while Damien falls into madness seeing his best friend steal his role from him. Damien tries everything to take back the role that was destined for him, even if it means ruining their friendship.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: Zoners
overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Face of Horror
overview: In medieval England, the beautiful Eleanor pines away for her errant husband, the handsome but adulterous knight Edward. When Edward’s treachery culminates in a tragedy that robs Eleanor first of her beauty and then of her life, she returns as a ghost to eke bloody revenge on Edward and his new bride.

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: Censor Addiction
overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Saving Black Bear
overview: When the departure of a longtime manager threatens to shutter an already struggling movie theater in small-town Maine, a band of misfit employees fights to save the place that brought them together.

title: The Spirit Lock
overview: Desperate to save their possessed son, a fractured couple turns to a cursed Pagan device—unleashing a greater evil that threatens their sanity, their marriage, and their souls.

title: Brown Sheep
overview: 16-year-old Jamila navigates adolescence and natural hair confidence whilst reminiscing her mother; and attending a predominantly white school.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Hong Kong, Let's Get Married
overview: This documentary follows Hong Kong’s same-sex marriage movement through court challenges, activism, and personal stories as couples and advocates pursue recognition and equality.

title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
overview: An anthology film on the theme of fairy tales - some lighthearted, some more serious in tone, but all with a sprinkle of magic - and all set in the East of England county of Suffolk!

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: The Ringing
overview: Jack suffers from relentless ringing in his ears that slowly isolates him from the world around him. As the noise grows unbearable and medical help fails, he takes a horrifying step to reclaim silence, with devastating consequences.

title: Against The Skin
overview: In a world driven by inherited beliefs, social noise, and quiet despair, a searching mind wrestles with the question of purpose, challenging whether humanity is truly living or simply surviving until it disappears.

title: Little Singer
overview: Amidst the horizons of Diné land, the legacy of historical trauma echos through generations. At the center, a medicine man and a small school, where grief and resilience meet in song, teaching, and k’é (kinship). Little Singer is rooted in land; carrying the vision and medicine of k’é forward.

title: Onslaught
overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Udders!
overview: Naked in a cornfield, a man runs for his life...

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Violent Delight
overview: A lonely artist draws her perfect companion-but the more he sees her, the more she loses herself.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: Another
overview: Joey, an author struggling to cope after her brilliant scientist husband, Ben, tragically dies. When Joey wakes one morning to find Ben making pancakes in their kitchen—as if nothing ever happened—her reality begins to fracture.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Spider Island
overview: A group of social media influencers go to the launch of a new hotel on a tropical island, where they find deadly spiders.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

title: Build Me a Time Machine
overview: Young Woman longs for the innocent feeling of childhood and struggles with the thought of trying to live.

title: Tomorrow, You Pretty Ghost
overview: Two high school theater kids, prone to playing elaborate tricks on their pals, pull off one last prank before graduation with grim consequences.

title: Desert Fiends 2
overview: A group of elite bounty hunters are on the trail to track down and kill The Desert Fiends. Meanwhile, a TikTok style influencer has come into town to have a meet up while the Desert Fiends are heading that way to eliminate that meet up.

title: The Headliner
overview: The Headliner is a multi-generational musical drama that explores the evolution, exploitation, and enduring spirit of hip-hop culture. The film follows a reclusive, legendary producer from the genre's "golden era" who is forced out of retirement to collaborate with a fiercely talented but unguided modern street rapper. As they clash over the soul of their music, they must unite to fight corporate greed and protect the artistic integrity of the culture.

title: In Bloom
overview: A witty intern resists her totalitarian society by igniting a government coup to protect her family.

title: Amityverse: End Game
overview: Third and final horror anthology in the Amityverse series, featuring 10 more Amityville-themed segments.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Motherhood
overview: From childhood onward, rules are imposed on us, behaviours are dictated to us, and we are told “how to live,” but we are never prepared for the difficulty of “being.” This film explores this question through the lens of motherhood.

title: The Pigeon
overview: A bereaved young woman believes her sister has been reincarnated, as a pigeon.

title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
original_title: Best Served Cold: How a Revenge Film was Buried for Decades
overview: A feature length cinema documentary on how THE FARMER (1977) became the most-requested cult film of the new millennium, and it's a crazy tale that involves an actor incarcerated for manslaughter, serious on-set injuries, banana-man costumes- as well as surprising links to Clint Eastwood and Martin Scorsese.  The film also broadens its scope to explore the overlooked, eclectic and often ultra-violent sub-genre THE FARMER belongs to - The Returning Veteran film. A film type that hit its stride in the 1970's with hard hitting character studies such as WELCOME HOME, SOLDIERS BOYS (1971), THE NO MERCY MAN (1973) and ROLLING THUNDER (1977).

title: The Angel in the House
overview: Angela is living a life devoted to everyone but herself. Disconnected from her husband, Malcolm, and struggling to articulate her dissatisfaction, she leaves home the night before her family is set to attend a wedding.

title: My Little Blue Heart
overview: In a near future in rural Britain, Mustafa and his deaf sister Amna are torn apart by immigration vigilantes and their far-right policies. Amna escapes to search for her brother, only to witness a tragic event.

title: Rocket Friendz
overview: In a world of mediocrity, Theo is a Rocket Friendz Battle Trainer with ONE goal: for he and his Rocket Friend Snout to BE THE BEST! He has been trying for 27 years!

title: 742 Evergreen
overview: Two on call police officers respond to a call, where they suspect everything is not what it seems
